name: Breckinridge County, KY
findings: Breckinridge County has 41 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Breckinridge County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Breckinridge County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
